sections.title: Current validation rules
sections.sql: select revision,author,reason,needs_review from v_contracts where event_id=$1

sections.title: Property requirements
sections.sql: select p.key property,coalesce(p.value->>'type','any') type,coalesce(c.schema->'required','[]') ? p.key required,p.value->>'enum' allowed_values,p.value->>'minimum' minimum,p.value->>'pattern' pattern from v_contracts c cross join lateral jsonb_each(c.schema->'properties') p where c.event_id=$1

sections.title: Coverage
sections.sql: select name,destination,revision,current_samples,to_char(last_observed,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') last_observed,failed_samples from v_coverage where id=$1

sections.title: Recorded findings
sections.sql: select observed_at,consent,findings from observations where event_id=$1 order by observed_at desc

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,resolution from issues where event_id=$1
